title: Dialectal Toxicity Detection: Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge Consistency Across Language Varieties

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' toxicity judgments across a dataset of 60 language varieties and 10 language clusters (generated via machine translation and dialect synthesis) to measure consistency between standard languages and non-standard dialects (Dialectal Consistency) as well as LLM-human agreement.

Incorporating real-world spoken utterances transcribed via speech-to-text (e.g., from a native Bengali speaker) to evaluate how natural speech accents and variations affect the LLM's toxicity assessments.
